exposure: self-reported Covid-19 impact on birth experience
cohort: Parents of babies born in South Africa during 2020 participated in an online survey about their birth and new parenting experiences.
finding: Preterm birth and self-reported Covid-19 impact on birth experience increased the odds of negative birth emotions, while having a preferred delivery method reduced these odds, and negative birth emotions in turn increased the odds of probable minor depression.
mod_finding: Having a preferred delivery method reduced the odds of negative birth emotions.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on birth and new parenting experiences during 2020 for babies born in South Africa during 2020.
